'''Bayrd''' is a solder, formerly a personal guard to [[Jarid Sarand]].

==History==
As a child, Bayrd's grandfather, [[Pappil]], taught him how to work stone.{{ref/book|14|p}}

==Activities==
After [[Arymilla Marne]]'s defeat during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]], Jarid's forces retreat from [[Caemlyn]] while still supporting [[Elenia Sarand]]. Bayrd and his men camp on the road to [[Whitebridge]] and are hit by a [[bubble of evil]] that turns all metal soft. Troubled by Jarid's increasing fervor to try and kill [[Elayne Trakand]], Bayrd and his men abandon Jarid and march for the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|p}}

He is then seen in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]] protecting Two Rivers archers with other andorans mercenaries.{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Bayrd is named after Thomas DeSimone, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. The name comes from a personal communication between DeSimone and Sanderson.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
